channel.title: The Nevada Independent - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Nevada Independent (thenevadaindependent.com)

item.title: ‘Wave elections can do funny things:’ With Amodei retiring, can Dems flip a House seat?
item.description: Plus: Canceled voter registrations and a heated rivalry leads to a heated endorsement.

item.title: Programa fiscal de Trump podría favorecer a escuelas privadas; críticos cuestionan beneficios para Nevada
item.description: A un grupo local en defensa de la educación pública le preocupa que el programa que impulsa el Presidente Donald Trump no beneficie tanto a Nevada como creen sus promotores.

item.title: Nevada moves to block prediction market Kalshi after 9th Circuit ruling clears way
item.description: Control board lawyers say the company’s sports contracts are unlicensed wagering, which harms the public and poses an existential threat to the gaming industry.

item.title: Exlíder Demócrata de la Asamblea, Teresa Benitez-Thompson, se postulará para representar a Nevada en el Congreso
item.description: Los Demócratas nunca han ganado ese escaño, pero dicen que el 2026 será su mejor oportunidad.

item.title: Report: 16 Nevada insurance carriers illegally give mental health care claims short shrift
item.description: A state lawmaker described the findings as “alarming” and a “disturbing realization” of how mental health care can be treated as second-tier to physical care.

item.title: Truckee Gaming has long focused up north. It’s now expanding with 2nd Vegas-area casino
item.description: North Las Vegas’ closed Poker Palace is being transformed into Club Fortune North for a planned April opening. Also, another tax-fix push by Titus.

item.title: ‘I lost a lot of hope’: Nevada pays $100K to woman convicted for miscarriage under 1911 law
item.description: The woman was charged under a law, unique to Nevada, that criminalizes taking drugs to end a pregnancy past 24 weeks.

item.title: Democrats have never won Northern Nevada’s 2nd District. These candidates think they can.
item.description: Prominent politicians already support several contenders, setting up a hotly contested primary.

item.title: OPINION: Supporting voter ID doesn’t make the SAVE Act a good idea
item.description: As recently as 2021, the GOP was insistent that elections remain primarily run by the states, objecting vehemently to the Democratic attempt to “strengthen voting rights” after the commotion and chaos of the 2020 election.

item.title: Nevada compensa a mujer quien fue condenada por aborto espontáneo bajo una antigua ley
item.description: Una mujer fue acusada bajo una ley, exclusiva de Nevada, que penaliza el consumo de medicamentos para interrumpir un embarazo después de 24 semanas de gestación.
